sources.title: Gwen Build Guide: The Passionate Guide On How To Use Scissors!

passive.name: A Thousand Cuts
passive.text: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

spells.name: Snip Snip!
spells.text: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

spells.name: Hallowed Mist
spells.text: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

spells.name: Skip 'n Slash
spells.text: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

spells.name: Needlework
spells.text: Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit. This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

damage.value: Gwen deals sustained percent-health and true damage to shred durable targets.

archetype.value: Gwen is an AP bruiser best suited for the top lane.

axis.value: Gwen relies heavily on poke to set up the fights she chooses.

winCondition.value: Gwen wins by shredding objectives and becoming a powerful late-game damage threat.

spikes.why: Its cooldown refund rises to 65% after an empowered attack hits.
Gwen can use Q more often as its cooldown falls from 6.5 to 3.5 seconds.

bait.why: Gwen loses her mist’s protection from enemies outside it while W is on cooldown.
Gwen cannot dash or gain E’s Attack Speed, range, and on-hit damage while E is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Gwen players may play too passively early because they underestimate her early-game pressure.
Gwen misses Q’s true damage and passive applications when her snips do not hit with their center.
